body:
> Currently I thought it leaked since the history prop expects an history object that must comply with history (V2!) API.

Yes this is what I mentioned in my comment. It isn't strictly speaking leak. Since [history](https://github.com/mjackson/history) and react-router share the same maintainers and that react-router v2 was made to decouple the history management and the routing parts, I have a very optimistic view on the subject.
